banner.title: We use cookies
banner.body: We use cookies to improve your experience. Non-essential cookies are only set with your consent.

preferences.title: Cookie Preferences
preferences.strictlyNecessaryDesc: Required for the site to function. These cannot be disabled.
preferences.functionalDesc: Remember your preferences (language, location, settings) so you do not have to re-enter them.
preferences.analyticsDesc: Help us understand how visitors use the site so we can improve it. All data is anonymised.
preferences.marketingDesc: Allow third-party content (such as YouTube videos) and relevant advertising. Disabled by default.
